source: ترجمة آلية أعدّها Claude لنص: التفسير الميسّر (الجزء بعد علامة [التفسير])
translator: Claude (Anthropic) — غير مراجَعة من مترجم بشري
scopeNote: ترجمة للتفسير فقط؛ لا تُترجم الآيات القرآنية. الأصل العربي الحرفي هو المرجع.

tafsir.muyassar-1: Have you considered the state of the one who denies the Resurrection and the Recompense?
tafsir.muyassar-2: That is the one who harshly and violently pushes away the orphan — whose father died while he was young — from his right, out of hardness of heart.
tafsir.muyassar-3: And he does not urge others to feed the needy who lacks what suffices him and meets his need — so how could he feed him himself?
tafsir.muyassar-4: So severe punishment awaits those who pray but are heedless of their prayer: they do not perform it properly, nor at its proper time.
tafsir.muyassar-5: So severe punishment awaits those who pray but are heedless of their prayer: they do not perform it properly, nor at its proper time.
tafsir.muyassar-6: Those who make a show of good deeds in order to be seen by people.
tafsir.muyassar-7: And who withhold the lending of small things whose lending causes no harm — utensils and the like — so they neither worshipped their Lord well nor did good to His creation.
